clauses.assertion: Only a club-scoped organizer or administrator can load the managed-games inventory, planner, and session controls; every unauthorized path fails closed.

tests.name: module registers owner and organizer route families
organizer access denial renders a fail-closed state
a club member without a planning role cannot create a managed game

clauses.assertion: The planner exposes only published packs containing exactly 20 reviewed questions and creates against the selected approved pack.

tests.name: planner creates against governed pack and schedule
an organizer cannot schedule an incomplete question pack

clauses.assertion: The organizer submits a validated future schedule through one idempotent server-owned planning mutation.

tests.name: planner creates against governed pack and schedule
planner retry preserves the original operation intent

clauses.assertion: Eligibility is selected from governed scopes; invitation-only sessions require one or more active, verified, unexpired club supporters selected through privacy-safe six-digit Fan IDs.

tests.name: organizer plans invitation-only game with an approved pack and Fan ID
planner binds invitation-only access to selected supporter identities
an organizer creates one audited invitation-only session for an active Fan ID

clauses.assertion: Only paired, same-club displays within the organizer's authorized home or venue scope are selectable and active assignments are unavailable.

tests.name: planner marks actively assigned displays unavailable
planner options expose complete packs, authorized credential-free displays, and one active privacy-safe Fan-ID invitee

clauses.assertion: The live-control surface exposes only the server-authorized activation and question-start transitions for the current versioned lifecycle state.

tests.name: live control submits only a visible allowed transition
live control allows only server-authorized transitions

clauses.assertion: The organizer supervises the authoritative session phase, participant count, question, assigned displays, versions, sequence, and server timing without answer-bearing content.
Completion and early-end actions remain versioned, reasoned, audited, idempotent, and limited to server-advertised transitions.

tests.name: live retry preserves idempotency key and phase deadline
reasoned early end completes the session
